claims.statement: Tom Allen was billed as retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt:
ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of
the world, 619 Markee street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street (printed as 'Markee street') offered a free concert every evening, with the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt:
619 Markee street. Free concert
every evening. The best of singers only en-
gaged.

notes: Advertisement in Sporting Notes, beside racing news; the street name is printed as 'Markee'.
